name: parallax-maker-frontend
description: Svelte 5 frontend for Parallax Maker (migration target for the Dash UI).

scripts.gen:api-types: cd .. && ${PYTHON:-.venv/bin/python} -m parallax_maker.api.schema_export frontend/src/lib/api/schema.json && cd frontend && json2ts -i src/lib/api/schema.json -o src/lib/api/generated.ts --unreachableDefinitions --additionalProperties false
